project: Wuxia Life P24 Playtest Calibration And Release Candidate Closure
description: Complete a player-facing playtest calibration and release-candidate closure pass for wuxia-life by auditing current external-validation blind spots, defining explicit playtest and RC judgment rules, extending profile-first calibration and reporting surfaces with minimal theme-neutral support, shipping representative comparison samples and a machine-readable validation matrix, and proving through one bounded RC wave plus a final closure report that internal acceptance signals align more reliably with real player-facing experience without adding UI work, a new theme, or a large runtime rewrite.

userStories.title: Audit current playtest and RC surfaces
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only audit of current playtest, external-feedback, and release-candidate surfaces so that P24 starts from the real calibration gaps instead of extending internal metrics blindly.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit the current external-validation surfaces across first-run clarity, onboarding readability, replay motivation, route differentiation, late-game payoff, and ending resonance
Record which surfaces are already observable through human feedback versus internal reports only
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Audit measurable versus weakly calibrated experience gaps
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only audit of measurable, partially proxyable, and still-uncalibrated experience surfaces so that later P24 work targets the weakest evidence boundaries first.
acceptanceCriteria: Identify which experience surfaces are already testable with human feedback, partially proxyable by internal reports, or still not meaningfully calibrated
Record the main risks where internal acceptance can pass while real-player experience still fails
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Write representative playtest-dimension rules
userStories.description: As a designer, I want explicit playtest dimensions in scope for P24 so that calibration work evaluates one coherent player-facing model instead of scattered intuitions.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the representative playtest dimensions in scope for P24
Define how calibration should combine first-run readability, replay desire, route distinction, consequence weight, and ending aftertaste
Save the rules under docs/designs/ or docs/

userStories.title: Write RC-quality improvement and deferral rules
userStories.description: As a designer, I want explicit RC-quality and deferral rules so that release decisions are judged by player-facing value rather than cleaner internal reports alone.
acceptanceCriteria: Define what counts as an RC-quality improvement versus a merely cleaner internal report
Define which playtest or release-candidate problems are explicitly deferred beyond P24
Save the rules under docs/designs/ or docs/

userStories.title: Define internal-external alignment indicator set
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a stable alignment indicator set so that internal quality signals can be compared against human playtest outcomes instead of being treated as self-validating.
acceptanceCriteria: Define 3-5 representative alignment indicators across onboarding clarity, replay motivation, route readability, payoff strength, and ending resonance
Ensure each indicator has a clear meaning for deciding whether internal reports are overestimating or underestimating player experience
Ensure the indicator set is suitable for future RC comparisons
Save the definition under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not require runtime redesign in this story
